Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Specialist Benelux role. With hands-on experience in SEO, GEO, content and WordPress, I am excited by the opportunity to grow three commercial vehicle brands across the Benelux.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I build and optimize websites for both traditional and AI-powered search. I have implemented structured data, llms.txt files and GEO initiatives to improve visibility in generative engines. I also manage CMS content, run SEO audits and use Google Analytics and Search Console to track performance. My technical background allows me to work effectively with developers and marketing tools.

I am fluent in English, native in Turkish and have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking). I am eager to develop my Dutch further and contribute to the Benelux market. The chance to combine digital marketing with B2B commercial goals in the automotive sector particularly appeals to me.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills can support your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Digital Marketing Specialist Benelux position. With a strong foundation in SEO, GEO, content and web development, I am drawn to the opportunity to support three commercial vehicle brands in growing their market presence across the Benelux.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in planning and executing digital marketing initiatives. I have built and optimized websites for both traditional and AI-powered search, implementing structured data, llms.txt files and GEO strategies to improve brand visibility. I regularly manage CMS content, conduct SEO audits and use tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track performance and derive actionable insights. My technical background in HTML, CSS and JavaScript enables me to collaborate effectively with developers and leverage AI tools for automation.

I have worked on B2B and B2C projects, including client websites in consultancy and e-commerce, where I focused on lead generation and customer engagement. I understand the importance of aligning marketing efforts with commercial priorities and enjoy translating business goals into concrete digital actions. The automotive sector's shift towards electric mobility particularly interests me, and I am eager to contribute to a company at the forefront of this transition.

I am fluent in English, native in Turkish and have a working knowledge of Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking). I am committed to further developing my Dutch to better serve the Benelux market. I am proactive, solution-oriented and enjoy taking ownership of projects from idea to execution.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and mindset can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• SEO & GEO expertise: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, structured data, llms.txt, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO).
• Hands-on digital marketing experience: managing SEO content, CMS (WordPress), and campaigns for client websites, with analytics via Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs.
• AI & automation skills: daily use of LLMs for research and content, prompt engineering, MCP integrations, Python automation, and front-end coding (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).
• B2B and B2C project exposure: worked on consultancy and e-commerce client sites, focusing on lead generation and customer engagement.
• Multilingual: fluent English, native Turkish, Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking) – eager to develop further for Benelux market.
